message.content: {"summary":"A well-structured report on a coral-reef monitoring mission that addresses nearly all requirements with good STK evidence. However, the inclination value (87.79° vs ~97.8° for SSO at 600 km), the Kourou latitude error, internal contradictions about thrusters, and weak referencing (bare URLs, Wikipedia) hold the design back from the top rubric levels.","next_steps":["Correct the sun-synchronous inclination: at 600 km an SSO requires ~97.8° (retrograde); verify against your own STK plot and ground tracks.","Fix the Kourou latitude (~5.2°N, not 45.05°N) and re-check any launch-vehicle performance implications that depend on it.","Resolve contradictions: state clearly whether the spacecraft has thrusters, and align manoeuvre/EOL discussion with that; also fix the statement that high altitude/low resolution is 'desirable'.","Replace Wikipedia and bare URLs with properly formatted citations to primary/technical sources, and ensure every in-text citation matches the reference list.","Strengthen the Conclusion with quantitative outcomes (orbit elements, access statistics, mission lifetime) and a brief critical evaluation of design trade-offs."],"criteria":{"C1":"Accomplished (7/10). Your Introduction clearly presents the mission (Great Barrier Reef monitoring), the rationale, the single-spacecraft justification and the users. To reach the top of the range, define the operator and customer segments more explicitly and deepen the referenced background discussion.","C2":"Adequate (6/10). You addressed all major requirements with STK screenshots, access reports and ground tracks, which is good evidence. However, the inclination (87.79° vs ~97.8° for SSO at 600 km), the Kourou latitude (~5.2°N, not 45.05°N), and contradictory thruster statements are significant technical errors. The Accomplished level requires accurate, internally consistent design supported by quality evidence.","C3":"Adequate (6/10). Your Conclusion summarises each segment and notes risks such as Vega E availability, but it largely recaps the report. The Accomplished level requires detailed conclusions drawn from your evidence — include quantitative outcomes and a critical evaluation of trade-offs.","C4":"Adequate (5/10). Your report has a clear structure, executive summary and labelled figures. To reach Accomplished: format references properly (no bare URLs, no Wikipedia), fix typos ('nurture', 'complied'), and make figure captions and formatting consistent throughout."}}
